job: Search, filter and act on a list, with controls wrapping instead of scrolling.
purpose: A row for the controls above a list: search, filters and view controls at the start, export and create at the end. When it does not fit on one line the search and the end group share the first line and the filters move together to the second; below 640px the filters become one row that scrolls sideways. It measures its nearest container and lives in a small-padded band.
useWhen: A table, list or grid needs search, filters and one create action.
View controls and export belong at the end of the row.

avoidWhen.when: The title row of a page.
A filter state that needs chips for what is applied.
Tabs that switch views of the same data.

variants.useWhen: The search takes the full row instead of its 280px maximum.

parts.role: The group pushed to the end.
Optional wrapper around the filters: one item on a desktop, the row that scrolls sideways below 640px.
